g.text: Each declared load feeds the fixed benchmark L-match; points compare whole-network input Z, not plasma-state physics.

g.text: Open circles: independent load + L-match equations. Crosses: ngspice extraction. Max |Z-component error|: CCP 4.58e-13 ohm; ICP 4.76e-10 ohm.
